newsitem.title: USA: Executive Risk CEO Vander Putten to retire.
newsitem.headline: Executive Risk CEO Vander Putten to retire.

text.p: Executive Risk Inc said Tuesday that its chairman and chief executive, Roy Vander Putten, will retire as an officer and director on May 30.
Robert Kullas, vice chairman and chief operating officer, has been elected by the board to become chairman on Vander Putten's retirement.
Stephen Sills, president and chief underwriting officer of Executive Risk, will succeed Vander Putten as chief executive and will retain his title as president.

At the same time, Robert Deutsch, executive vice president, chief financial officer and chief actuary, will become president of Executive Risk's two insurance company subsidiaries, Executive Risk Indemnity Inc. and Executive Risk Specialty Insurance Co.
